collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQB 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQB 2021 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade the drivers side and an 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this EQB which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
